The fraud was identified by scanning the card's transaction window in the graph for recurring bursts of similar transactions.

sar.narrative: Customer C06881, holder of card C06881-K1, is the subject of this report. Between 2016-12-03 20:00 and 2016-12-03 20:30, 4 transaction(s) totalling $1,880.16 were made on the card online from device profile 'iOS Device | iOS 11.2.2 | mobile safari 11.0 | 2208x1242': $462.13 (3510950, 2016-12-03 20:00), $480.53 (3510982, 2016-12-03 20:07), $464.58 (3511041, 2016-12-03 20:24), $472.92 (3511062, 2016-12-03 20:30). Every amount sat just below $500 and the purchases were placed minutes apart, a pattern consistent with deliberately staying under an authorisation threshold. The activity is suspicious because: 4 online purchases within 30 minutes, each between $400 and $500 ($462.13, $480.53, $464.58, $472.92; total $1,880.16). It closely resembles earlier confirmed fraud cases CC-3748, CC-3841, CC-3907. The bank has recommended blocking and reissuing the card, placing linked cards under monitoring where applicable, and retaining the transaction, device and investigation records as supporting documentation.
